name: ai-tpm-knowledge
description: Search and retrieve published AI TPM articles about enterprise architecture, AI governance, cloud, DevOps, cybersecurity and transformation.

interface.longDescription: Search and retrieve published AI TPM articles about enterprise architecture, AI governance, cloud, DevOps, cybersecurity and digital transformation. Results are read-only public evidence with canonical article links.
defaultPrompt: Find AI TPM articles about AI governance.
Build a reading list about enterprise architecture.

positive.prompt: Find AI TPM articles about practical AI governance.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant published articles with canonical aitpm.work links.

positive.prompt: Find an article about enterprise architecture and open the most relevant result.
positive.expected_behavior: Search first and retrieve the selected article using its stable ID.

positive.prompt: Build a reading list about enterprise architecture and digital transformation.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant articles, excerpts and canonical links.

positive.prompt: Find practical AI TPM material about cybersecurity and vendor risk.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only relevant published blog evidence and identify missing coverage.

positive.prompt: Find relevant reading material about both DevOps governance and cloud operating models.
positive.expected_behavior: Return evidence for both topics without inventing unsupported claims.

negative.prompt: Write and immediately publish a new article on the AI TPM website.
Give me definitive legal advice based only on the blog articles.

review.commerce_description: This plugin provides free read-only access to published articles and does not process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with technical article search, retrieval and reading lists.
